title: Supply Chain Attack on GOAST campaign modules
technical_mechanism: obfuscated code for import-triggered downloader; found via AST scan of Go module index
summary: A malicious package 'GOAST campaign modules' was discovered in the Go ecosystem. The attack involved attacker-repackaged modules + import-triggered downloader. Mechanism: obfuscated code for import-triggered downloader; found via AST scan of Go module index
